name: Defensive Slide at Game Speed
setup: Defensive stance: feet wider than the shoulders, knees bent, hips low, hands active.
cues: Full game speed now: if your form slips, drop back to the slower version.
Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.
Push the floor away with the trail foot; the lead foot reaches.

faults.fix: Stay under the low ceiling: the head travels flat.
Keep a gap between the shoes the whole slide.

faults.fault: Reaching with the hands, not moving the feet
faults.fix: Beat the cone there with the feet first.
